achievements.name: Tyger Tyger, burning bright
achievements.description: Complete the opening Tiger Hunter stories

achievements.name: ...And That's How You Do It
achievements.description: Complete all Tank Academy missions.

achievements.name: Trial by Fire
achievements.description: Fight in a Random Battle.

achievements.name: According to Plan
achievements.description: Research and purchase a Tier V vehicle.

achievements.name: On the Road to Perfection
achievements.description: Research and purchase a Tier VI vehicle.

achievements.name: We're Gonna Need Bigger Guns!
achievements.description: Research and purchase a Tier VII vehicle.

achievements.name: Works Like a Dream
achievements.description: Research and purchase a Tier VIII vehicle.

achievements.name: Nine Out of Ten
achievements.description: Research and purchase a Tier IX vehicle.

achievements.name: Top Shelf
achievements.description: Research and purchase a Tier X vehicle.

achievements.name: Earning Your Stripes
achievements.description: Complete one Personal Mission.

achievements.name: On the Right Track
achievements.description: Complete all Personal Missions in a set.

achievements.name: Smooth Operation
achievements.description: Complete all Personal Missions in the same operation.

achievements.name: Pocket Money
achievements.description: Earn 1,000,000 credits in Random Battles. Credits received for Standard Account are counted (including credits received for courageous resistance).

achievements.name: Toss a Coin
achievements.description: Earn 5,000,000 credits in Random Battles. Credits received for Standard Account are counted (including credits received for courageous resistance).

achievements.name: King Midas
achievements.description: Earn 15,000,000 credits in Random Battles. Credits received for Standard Account are counted (including credits received for courageous resistance).

achievements.name: Quick Learner
achievements.description: Earn 10,000 experience in Random Battles. Experience received for Standard Account is counted (including experience received for courageous resistance).

achievements.name: Battle-Hardened
achievements.description: Earn 50,000 experience in Random Battles. Experience received for Standard Account is counted (including experience received for courageous resistance).

achievements.name: Experience Is the Best Teacher
achievements.description: Earn 100,000 experience in Random Battles. Experience received for Standard Account is counted (including experience received for courageous resistance).

achievements.name: Save It for Later
achievements.description: Earn a total of 1,000 Free Experience in Random Battles. Free Experience received for Standard Account is counted (including Free Experience received for courageous resistance).

achievements.name: An All-Purpose Resource
achievements.description: Earn a total of 2,500 Free Experience in Random Battles. Free Experience received for Standard Account is counted (including Free Experience received for courageous resistance).

achievements.name: Knowledge Is Power!
achievements.description: Earn a total of 5,000 Free Experience in Random Battles. Free Experience received for Standard Account is counted (including Free Experience received for courageous resistance).

achievements.name: Heavy-Duty
achievements.description: Block a total of 15,000 HP of damage in Random Battles when fighting in heavy tanks.

achievements.name: Sweet Spot
achievements.description: Enable your allies to cause 15,000 HP of damage to vehicles spotted by you in Random Battles when fighting in light tanks.

achievements.name: A Real Stunner
achievements.description: Stun enemy vehicles for a total of 500 seconds in Random Battles when fighting in SPGs. Potential stun duration is counted.

achievements.name: Finding a Happy Medium
achievements.description: Cause a total of 25,000 HP of damage to enemy vehicles in Random Battles when playing in medium tanks.

achievements.name: Hunter
achievements.description: Cause a total of 25,000 HP of damage to enemy vehicles in Random Battles when playing in tank destroyers.

achievements.name: A Tough Nut to Crack
achievements.description: Cause, receive, and block a total of 3,000 HP of damage in one Random Battle when playing in a heavy tank.

achievements.name: Far-Reaching Support
achievements.description: Enable your allies to cause 500 HP of damage in one Random Battle by stunning or immobilizing enemy vehicles when playing in an SPG.

achievements.name: Small but Smart
achievements.description: Cause and/or enable your allies to cause at least 2,000 HP of damage in one Random Battle when playing in a light tank.

achievements.name: Tank Hunter
achievements.description: Cause 1,500 HP of damage and destroy two enemy vehicles in one Random Battle when playing in a tank destroyer.

achievements.name: Masterclass
achievements.description: Cause 2,000 HP of damage to enemy vehicles in one Random Battle when playing in a medium tank.

achievements.name: It Ain't Much, but It's Honest Work
achievements.description: Destroy 50 enemy vehicles in Random Battles.

achievements.name: Nothing Personal
achievements.description: Destroy 250 enemy vehicles in Random Battles.

achievements.name: This Is Just the Beginning
achievements.description: Destroy 500 enemy vehicles in Random Battles.

achievements.name: Not Great, Not Terrible
achievements.description: Receive the Mastery Badge Class I or higher.

achievements.name: Acing It
achievements.description: Receive the Ace Tanker Mastery Badge.

achievements.name: Three Cheers
achievements.description: Receive three Ace Tanker Mastery Badges.

achievements.name: High Five
achievements.description: Receive five Ace Tanker Mastery Badges.

achievements.name: Penetration!
achievements.description: Score a total of 1,000 armor-penetrating hits on enemy vehicles in Random Battles.

achievements.name: On the March
achievements.description: Cover a total distance of 500,000 meters in Random Battles.

achievements.name: David and Goliath
achievements.description: Destroy an enemy vehicle two tiers higher than yours in a Random Battle.

achievements.name: Boy Scout
achievements.description: Use a type of consumables at least three times in a Random Battle. Repair Kits, First Aid Kits, and Fire Extinguishers of the same type are counted.

achievements.name: Last Man Standing
achievements.description: Be the last player on your team to be destroyed by the enemy.

achievements.name: Dodge This
achievements.description: Destroy at least one enemy vehicle by ramming in a Random Battle.

achievements.name: Precise Hit
achievements.description: Earn the Bruiser award.

achievements.name: A Whole New Level
achievements.description: Earn the Top Gun award.

achievements.name: Is That Adamantium?
achievements.description: Earn the Steel Wall award.

achievements.name: One-Two Punch
achievements.description: Destroy two enemy vehicles using different types of shells in a Random Battle.

achievements.name: You Can't See Me
achievements.description: Destroy two Tier IV–X enemy light tanks in a Random Battle.

achievements.name: Superiority Distance
achievements.description: Destroy an enemy vehicle in a Random Battle while remaining unspotted.

achievements.name: End of the Line
achievements.description: Destroy the tracks of 100 different enemy vehicles in Random Battles.

achievements.name: Top League
achievements.description: Win and be the top player on your team by experience earned in a Random Battle five times while playing in Tier X vehicles.

achievements.name: Main Gun
achievements.description: Cause damage that equals at least 25% of the total HP of enemy vehicles in a Random Battle.

achievements.name: All Your Base
achievements.description: Earn a total of 1,000 base defence or capture points in Random Battles. Points for resetting base capture and/or successfully capturing the enemy base are counted.

achievements.name: Decorated War Hero
achievements.description: Earn 10 awards in the Battle Heroes category.

achievements.name: Found You!
achievements.description: Spot 100 enemy vehicles in Random Battles.

achievements.name: I Am Invincible!
achievements.description: Block twice as much damage as the number of hit points of your vehicle in one Random Battle.

achievements.name: I Shall Be Your Eyes
achievements.description: Enable your allies to cause twice as much damage as the number of hit points of your own vehicle to enemy vehicles spotted by you in one Random Battle.

achievements.name: Left Click to Shoot
achievements.description: Cause twice as much damage as the number of hit points of your vehicle in one Random Battle.

achievements.name: Above and Beyond
achievements.description: Research and purchase a Tier XI vehicle.
